checks: Six logical categories, one canonical entry per tool; synonyms do not duplicate functions across drawers
Palette and data-table drawers stay on the chosen task after real canvas selection; no automatic return to generic properties or an empty pane
Repeated Tools collapse/reopen stays on the selected tool; Back preserves category; direct synonym search focuses real fields and cancels real colour preview
Border draft survives collapse and category return; Save excludes it and Cancel restores committed state/history
Clipboard, panel scaling, guides, layout, output and character controls remain reachable in narrow/Pearl/bilingual views; original SVG, observations and analysis unchanged
5000 actual primitives: search/colour/one Undo/redo/save/reopen preserve exact state and source; no timing claim

Actual public-domain H&E microscopy: canonical image-display entry, live contrast filter, Save excludes draft, Cancel restores exact source/state, separate physical calibration entry; no calibration inferred
